d: Watch this video as Firstpost exposes Emmanuel Macron’s desperate final gamble to salvage France's collapsing influence in Africa. After being humiliatingly expelled from military partnerships across the Sahel—including Mali, Burkina Faso, and Niger—Paris has secretly dispatched a top diplomatic envoy to Algiers in a desperate bid to reset ties with Algerian President Abdelmadjid Tebboune. But while Macron tries to buy back influence with covert diplomacy, Paris is simultaneously weaponizing the European Union to slap trade pressure on Algiers.
